svg.title: Figure 12. Steps in saving a vaccination record
svg.desc: The staff member enters a vaccination that was already given. The system checks access and the entry before saving it.

g.text: Validate entry; check repeat dose; save
Also try to note who made the change
FIGURE 12. STEPS IN SAVING A VACCINATION RECORD
Connected system: success path; entry or save failures stop it
ALTERNATIVE: A CHECK OR SAVE FAILS
Stop the success path above. Show the problem instead of a saved-record message.
Ask staff to sign in, correct the details, or check an existing dose record.
If the result is unclear, check the record before trying again.
